name: InterContinental Madrid
positioning: Historic grand hotel on Madrid's Paseo de la Castellana, opened in 1953 as Spain's first international luxury hotel, with a marble-lined lobby, a garden terrace and suites overlooking the boulevard
best_for: Travelers who want a classic grand hotel with a long history of famous guests
Guests who want to walk to museums and the high-end shopping of Salamanca
Suite guests who value a private club lounge and reception

facts.text: The hotel sits on Paseo de la Castellana, within walking distance of museums and high-end shopping in Salamanca.
The hotel is close to Salamanca, a luxury shopping district.
The InterContinental opened in 1953 as Spain's first international luxury hotel.
The hotel has hosted celebrities from Ava Gardner and Charlton Heston to visiting heads of state.
The hotel has a marble-lined lobby, where live music plays for diners.
Rooms and suites may include a view of the Castellana.
The Royal Suite has a living room, a private dining room, a kitchenette and a bath designed by Philippe Starck.
Club InterContinental gives suite guests an independent reception and a private buffet breakfast.
The 24/7 Fitness Studio has Technogym equipment, with Pilates and yoga classes.
Treatments include massages and facials, and there is a Swedish sauna.
At El Jardin restaurant, Chef Miguel de la Fuente cooks traditional Spanish cuisine with international influences.
The Sunday Brunch has live music and a pastry master class for kids.

highlights.text: The InterContinental opened in 1953 as Spain's first international luxury hotel.
The Ava Suite is a tribute to Ava Gardner, with a terrace overlooking Paseo de la Castellana.
The Royal Suite has a terrace with views of the Madrid skyline.
The second-floor Club InterContinental lounge overlooks the sidewalks below, with complimentary meals and evening drinks.
The lounge of the El Jardin terrace is a place to unwind with a glass of wine and tapas in a tropical garden.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
WhataHotel notes the location is in the business district, not the historic center.
